input.question: ELI5: How do people find out crazy specific glitches in games? Like walking in certain directions a certain number of steps and doing other very specific tasks in order to make a Mew pop up or something.
input.ground_truth: This applies: _URL_0_ When you have thousands of people interacting with something, some of them are bound to find things you never intended. This is often why it seems like some developers release "broken" games. Not because they didn't test the game, they probably spend a lot of time testing, but there is only so much testing that a handful of people can do in a month vs 10,000 people in a few hours. So developers honestly thought their game was solid. My friend once made a very very simple text based strategy game. A sort of "rock-paper-scissors" style game where you buy units and attack each other. I found that if you "buy" a negative number of units, it would actually give you the units AND the money you gain from "winning" a battle. My friend never even thought to test using a negative value, so from his perspective, the game was solid, but it wasnt till he let others begin testing it till the bug was found.

That’s a great habit! Taking the time to care for your appearance can really set a positive tone for your day. Many people find that grooming rituals—like shaving and trimming a beard—help them feel more confident, put-together, and ready to take on whatever comes their way. It’s not just about how you look to others, but also about the sense of self-care and intention you give yourself in the morning.

If it makes you feel prepared and boosts your confidence, then it’s definitely worth continuing. Plus, small routines like this can become a kind of mindfulness practice, helping you start your day with focus and calm. Well done on recognizing what works for you!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: ELI5: How do people find out crazy specific glitches in games? Like walking in certain directions a certain number of steps and doing other very specific tasks in order to make a Mew pop up or something.

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine you have a big, super fun toy box (that’s like a video game). Inside the toy box, there are all sorts of toys and secret tricks that most kids don’t know about.

Now, some grown-ups and big kids who really, really love this toy box like to play with it all the time. They try pushing buttons in weird ways, jumping in funny spots, or doing things over and over, just to see what happens. Sometimes, if they do the right (or wrong!) steps in the right order, the toy box does something silly or unexpected, like a toy cat pops out of nowhere or a toy car starts flying!

These silly things happening are called “glitches.” They happen because the toy box (the game) was made by people, and sometimes the rules inside the toy box get a little mixed up. When you do just the right (or just the wrong!) moves, you can make the toy box show you these funny mistakes.

So, people find these crazy glitches by playing a lot, trying lots of different things, and noticing when something weird happens. It’s like being a detective in the toy box!
